title: Avenger Street 160 ABS
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Bajaj Auto Avenger Street 160 ABS is engineered for relaxed boulevard cruising backed by muscular roll-on passing power. At its heart lies a 160cc powertrain delivering 12 HP and 10 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 110 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with an accessible 705mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, backed by a 5.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
